nodes.title: Original settings preserved — read first
widgets_values:
Built from the ORIGINAL 10sorlabs file. All original positional widget values and enabled modes are preserved, including both samplers, 1448x2176 resolution, FaceDetailer, LoRA stack, upscaler, comparison routing and save prefixes.

Upload the reference and edit the new Identity Edit instruction. Original text prompt nodes remain visible but no longer drive main sampling.

Additional LoRAs stay in the original Power LoRA Loader. They feed the ordinary FaceDetailer and, separately, Identity Edit. Identity Edit is applied only to the two reference-conditioned main passes.

EmptyLatentImage was replaced with EmptySD3LatentImage, preserving width/height/batch, for the Krea reference path.

No conflicting named widget fields. Static checks passed; GPU output has not been tested. Original high resolution, four-step settings, and original LoRA loader compatibility are retained intentionally, not endorsed as optimal for Identity Edit.

nodes.title: New options — switching FaceDetailer / PhotoLab
widgets_values:
UPDATED COPY: Starting size is 1152 x 1728 = 1,990,656 pixels (1.99 MP). This supersedes the original note about preserving 1448 x 2176. Other original settings are unchanged.

Krea2T Enhancer is enabled at strength 1.0 on the FIRST Identity Edit pass only, after Identity Edit LoRA and before the first model patch.

DEFAULT: FaceDetailer enabled, PhotoLab bypassed.
PHOTOLAB INSTEAD: Bypass FaceDetailer #1611; set PhotoLab #1829 to Always (unbypass). Both the final Save Image and final comparison follow PhotoLab output. Bypass BOTH for no final retouch.

PhotoLab is configured for skin-tone masking and mild frequency-separation retouch only. Diffusion, automatic depth, and other effects are disabled. No extra diffusion model is needed for this preset. Tune skin mask/smoothing in Retouch & AI.

Requires ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer and ComfyUI-MrWeazPhotoLab installed on the ComfyUI machine. JSON structure/connections checked; GPU and UI execution not tested.

nodes.title: Identity Edit instruction
widgets_values:
Mirror selfie.

Preserve the woman’s identity and facial features from the reference image, with long dark hair, light-blue eyes with catchlights, and long legs. Allow her gaze and chin position to change for the selfie.

She has just finished an intense workout. Her skin is visibly drenched in sweat: distinct raised beads across her forehead and upper lip, larger droplets on her temples, collarbones, shoulders, and arms, and thin wet trails descending along her neck and exposed waist. A continuous damp sheen connects the droplets. Her hair is wet at the roots, with damp strands clinging to her neck. Keep the mirror clean so the moisture is clearly on her body.

Replace her current clothing with a sweat-soaked black tank top with a very low-cut, deeply plunging neckline and large oval side cutouts from beneath the armpits toward the hips. The opaque fabric has irregular saturated patches and clings in damp folds. Add fitted black leggings and a thin silver waist chain.

Place her in a dim bathroom in a suburban Florida house. She holds an iPhone vertically beside her face, slightly below eye level, with its screen facing her and rear cameras facing the mirror. Her chin dips slightly and both pupils turn down toward the phone screen as she checks the composition. Her free hand holds a towel at her hip.

View the reflection through the phone’s rear camera. One coherent reflection, one phone, face unobstructed. A dim warm light beside the mirror grazes her skin, making individual sweat beads glint while the bathroom stays dark. Flash off.

Vertical 4:5 framing from head to upper thighs, slight camera tilt, natural low-light grain. No interface, text, or watermark.
